authority: Operator decision returned in plans/fieldwise_operator_input_pack.md item 13, folded into Tier 3 by plans/fieldwise_tickets.md ticket 6. Recorded per CLAUDE.md §9.4; status per §12.2.
decision: Both candidate statements are accepted unchanged. Security screening: no concerns arise. Green Charter: six commitments, four of which the draft already supports.
why: Part B-2 §7 and §8 need both statements at submission. The draft supplies nothing for §7 and real material for §8 in §1.2 without naming the Charter. This run does not draft Part B-2, so the statements are held in Tier 3 rather than consumed by a phase.
security_screening: The project handles no classified or EU-restricted information. It uses open Copernicus data and institutional field measurements. It involves no dual-use goods or technology and no entity established outside the EU.

green_charter_commitments.commitment: Reuse before regeneration: the five-year MATE archive is the primary data source rather than a new campaign
Prefer the simplest adequate model, introducing deep architectures only where sample size and temporal density justify them
Run computation on shared ELTE infrastructure rather than provisioning dedicated hardware
Travel: default to remote collaboration, with at most one physical visit to MVCRI per growing season and shared transport for field campaigns
Conferences: hybrid attendance by default, at most one in-person conference per year
Purpose: the project targets better irrigation timing, which serves the Charter's environmental aim directly

consistency_check: The security statement's claim that no entity is established outside the EU is true of the consortium as it stands — ELTE and MATE in Hungary, MVCRI in Bulgaria, AgroVIR in Hungary — and stays true under the item 2 placement decision. Recorded so the fold does not re-derive it.
gate_effect: None. No runner gate reads this item; section_schema_registry.json marks Part B-2 sections 4 to 8 as out of scope for this run.
